loadErrorDesc: Your blocks are still in place. Try again.
noneBlocked: You haven't blocked anyone. Use the More menu on a profile or chat to block or report a member.
tooMany: Too many actions in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
noConnection: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
reportFailed: Couldn't send your report. Please try again.
reportReceivedDesc: Our team reviews every report. {{name}} is not told who reported them.
emergency: If you are in immediate danger, call 112.
whatHappened: What happened? {{name}} won't be told you reported them.
blockFailed: Couldn't block this member. Please try again.
blockDesc: You will not see each other, and neither of you can message or call the other. Any match between you ends. {{name}} is not told. You can unblock later from Settings.
